upgrade_monster_baiter: Upgrade the Wild Monster Baiter to increase size of attack
fp_snipercannon: You may still be safe from other players, but Wild Monsters remain at large. Build Sniper and Cannon Towers to protect your valuable resources.
fp_radiotower: Nervous about leaving your Yard vulnerable? Build a Radio Tower and get attack alerts while you're away.
fp_locker: Pokeys are fun, but there's a great big world of monsters out there. Build a Monster Locker and unlock bigger, stronger beasts.
fp_booby: You can now build Booby Traps! Strategically place these around your base to blow up any unsuspecting monsters who happen to step on them.
fp_blocks1: Tighten your defenses with Blocks. Use them to protect your buildings, or to funnel attacking monsters into Booby Traps.
fp_catapult1: Want to shred enemy buildings before flinging in a single monster? Build a Catapult and rain Twig Missiles on their defenses.
fp_blocks2: Wooden Blocks are great, but Stone Blocks will withstand more damage. Upgrade to Stone Blocks now!
fp_academy: Help your monsters gain strength, speed and durability when they earn their PhD in Advanced Destruction. Build a Monster Academy now.
fp_hcc_title: All Your Hatcheries Belong to Us
fp_hcc: Manage monster creation throughout your base from a single location with the Incubation Control Station. Build one now.
fp_planner: With the Yard Planner, you can get a birds-eye view of your base and easily rearrange buildings to bolster your defenses. Build one now!
fp_juicer: Need more Magma? Construct a Juicer and grind monsters you no longer need back into Magma...and a little blood.
fp_bunker: Towers can only do so much when it comes to defense. Build a Bunker and let your monsters pull their weight in keeping your yard safe.
fp_baiter: Not sure how your defenses stack up? Test them with the Wild Monster Baiter and make modifications as needed. Build one now.
fp_tesla: Monsters love resources, but they hate electricity.  Build a high voltage Tesla Tower to zap any enemy that gets too close.
fp_laser: Who couldn't use more fire or plasma power? The Laser Tower will make short work of any monsters within range. Build one now.
fp_aerial: What has deadly aim and will protect you from flying monsters that many defenses miss? An Aerial Defense Tower. Build one now.
fp_cage: No attacking force is complete without a champion leading the charge. Build a Champion Cage and raise one of your very own.
fp_blocks3: More Blocks equals more durability. Upgrade your Blocks to Metal now.
fp_chamber: Want to raise a new Champion but can't bear to part with your old one? With the Champion Chamber, you can put him on ice while you raise another. Build a Chamber now and keep one of each frozen and thaw them out as you like.
fp_heavy_title: What They Can't See, CAN Hurt Them!
fp_heavy: Heavy Traps use a specialized trigger that only fires when the most powerful monsters step on it. Lay Traps now and watch the mighty fall.
fp_catapult2: Upgrade your Catapult now, and you'll be able to launch a Pebble Bomb that will cause more damage over a larger area.
fp_fortifications: Now you can fortify your buildings with extra layers of defense that slow down enemy monsters and help protect your valuable resources. Begin fortifying now!
fp_monsterlab: Build the Monster Laboratory and research top secret abilities for your monsters.
fp_railgun: Line'em up and mow'em down with an electrical gun that makes up for its limited range with high damage and an infinite line of fire. Build a Railgun Tower now.
fp_blocks4: With more hitpoints, Gold Blocks will make your defenses stronger than ever before. Upgrade now!
fp_catapult3: Using Putty Rage in your next attack will send your monsters into a frenzy -- they'll attack faster, move faster, and bring your enemies down faster than ever. Launch it with the Catapult now.
fp_blocks5: Upgrade your Blocks to Black Diamond, and they'll be nearly impassable.
fp_alliances: Create or join an Alliance to protect yourself, aid friends or go after your greatest rival.
fp_strongbox: What's a whole new yard without a whole new set of monsters? Build a Strongbox and start unlocking these underworld beasts.
fp_sharpblast: You can be sure the enemy is just waiting for the chance to swipe your resources. Put up some Sharpshooters and Blast Towers to keep 'em at bay.
fp_chaos: Spread more death and destruction to your foes. Build the Chaos Lab and Factory to construct new weapons for battle.
fp_monstroe: No one's immune to Marilyn Monstroe's charms. Unlock her in the Chaos Lab and use her feminine wiles to lure defending monsters into her explosive grasp.
fp_loototron: Get a head start on looting your enemies. The Loot-O-Tron 5000 will latch onto the top of enemy Under Halls and suck the resources right out of them. Unlock it now in the Chaos Lab.
fp_candyjars: Put a lid on enemy defenses. Drop empty Candy Jars on defensive towers to keep them occupied while you go in for the kill. Unlock them now in the Chaos Lab.
fp_quakeabove: Harness the power of the underworld! Get a Quake Tower in Inferno as well as your Backyard. However, you will need an Inferno Yard to collect Bone, Coal, and Sulfur in order to construct this devastating tower. Build now.
fp_quake: Harness the power of the underworld! Get a Quake Tower in Inferno as well as your Backyard. However, you will need an Inferno Yard to collect Bone, Coal, and Sulfur in order to construct this devastating tower. Build now.
fp_magma: Your Inferno worker has secrets to tell. He's finally sharing... with a little encouragement. The secret to the Magma Tower is now yours. Build one now.
fp_infacademy: Take your Inferno Monsters to the next level. Build the Infernal Academy and make your underground demons more powerful through a boot camp from hell.
fp_idlelocker: Don't let your Monster Locker sit idle. Start unlocking the #v1#.
fp_idleacademy: Your monsters can cause even more damage if you teach them a thing or two. Open an Academy and whip them into shape.
fp_idlemonsterlab: Teach your monsters new and powerful abilities. Don't let your Monster Laboratory sit idle for too long.
fp_idledescent: There's a strange new world beneath your feet. Fight your way to Moloch and claim your Inferno Base now -- new monsters, new weapons, new enemies to crush. Start the Descent!
fp_idlechaos: Chaos Weapons are ideal for torturing your enemies. Open your Chaos Lab and start #v1# #v2# now!
fp_idlestrongbox: Put your Strongbox to work. Start unlocking the #v1#.
fp_idleinfacademy: Your Inferno monsters are waiting to learn a few tricks. Open an Infernal Academy and whip them into shape.
fp_idlemr2: Shake up your worldview with a Level 2 Map Room and expand your empire -- more resources, more yards, and more victims await you. Upgrade to Level 2 now.
fp_3_14_0: Fire and brimstone have spread to your Yard -- build a Magma Tower above ground and send enemy monsters scattering for cover.
fp_magmaabove: Fire and brimstone have spread to your Yard -- build a Magma Tower above ground and send enemy monsters scattering for cover.
str_code_enli_stream: #fname# just expanded their Inferno Yard by another 10%.
str_code_enli_streambody: Pop the champagne, #fname# just purchased more land to build on.
str_code_enli_body: Your Inferno yard is now larger than ever, giving you more space to build.
fp_event1pop1: Your monsters are growing restless. Word of the new Wild Brukkarg Tribe has spread, and your beasts crave their blood. Go on the offensive and destroy the Brukkarg Tribe before they set roots.
fp_event1pop2: Your monsters are ferocious, but they have yet to be truly tested. Lead them to victory by attacking the lethal Brukkarg Tribe and earn the respect of your enemies.
fp_event1pop3: The time is close at hand. Are you ready to draw first blood? The Brukkarg Tribe will not be easy to put down. Prepare for combat.
fp_event1start: Let the slaughter begin! Attack the battle-hardened Brukkarg Tribe and eliminate all their yards. Destroy them and add Vorg to your arsenal -- his healing touch will come in handy when things get bloody.
fp_event1reward_title: The Trick to a Good Victory...
fp_event1reward: Congratulations! Victory, Vorg, and his mysterious healing properties are now yours.
fp_event1end: The Brukkarg are already a distant memory, but there's always a tribe that needs to suffer your art of war.
event1reward_streamtitle: #fname# destroyed the Brukkarg Tribe in Backyard Monsters: Creature Carnage.
event1reward_streambody: There's nothing left of the Brukkarg to claim but teeth, claws, and dented armor.
fp_event2pop1: Rumors have begun to spread across the Backyard Universe. Wild Monsters seem bent on learning the secrets of your defenses by tearing them down, one piece at a time. Can your fortifications withstand the onslaught?
fp_event2pop2: Can your Towers defend the home base you've worked so hard to create? We'll soon find out.
fp_event2pop3: Wild Monsters continue to plot to overthrow your Yard and adopt your defensive strategies for their own. When they come for you, it won't be pretty. Prepare for the fury.
fp_event2start: That rumble you hear is a horde of Wild Monsters coming to lay claim to your yard. Battle through 10 Waves of Wild Monster attacks. Defend your Yard and win an unholy creature birthed in the fire swamps -- terror, thy name is Slimeattikus.
fp_event2reward: Congratulations! Slimeattikus now belongs to you. Corner this fissioning monster, and the last thing you'll hear is your own screams.
fp_event2end: In the Backyard, some truths are universal -- never let your guard down.
event2reward_streamtitle: #fname# dominated Monster Blitzkrieg in Backyard Monsters.
event2reward_streambody: Blood on the grass and enemy monster bones in your teeth -- it's a good day to be alive.
fp_event3pop1: Moloch, a sneaky underworld overlord, has grown tired of his own domain and is ready to make a play for yours. His minions don't play fair. Keep your wits about you...
fp_event3pop2: Moloch is through laying low. Are you strong enough to defeat his hellish beasts? With a little luck and a lot of strategy, you can survive.
fp_event3pop3: Moloch's Inferno Monsters are planning a full-scale assault on your Yard. How many hits can you stand? Crush 10 Waves of Monsters and prove you're invincible.
fp_event3start: Let the bloodbath begin! Moloch's Inferno Monsters have only one purpose -- to destroy. Litter your Yard with their limbs and claim total victory by crushing 10 Waves. Win access to two Magma Towers for your Main Yard.
fp_event3reward: Congratulations! You've won two Magma Towers. Let the blood and lava flow!
fp_event3end: Moloch's gone back to his underground lair to lick his wounds, but he's never down for long.
event3reward_streamtitle: #fname# defeated the beasts of Inferno in Backyard Monsters: Hell-Raisers.
event3reward_streambody: Nothing's hotter than Inferno Monsters charbroiled in your own backyard.
fp_3_16_0: Don't be surprised to see familiar faces -- your Inferno Map is now synced with your above ground Map Room. You can also extend the reach of you underground lair by purchasing Yard Expansion for your Inferno Base.
mon_vorgdesc: Hatched in giant hives deep inside the asteroid belt, Vorg are flying alien healers with a penchant for mischief.
msg_rsvpconfirmed: You're all set to receive updates at #v1#.
fp_3_17_0: Are your monsters in need of medical attention? Vorg, an alien hatched deep inside the asteroid belt, is at your service. Unlock this winged healer now in the Monster Locker.
mon_vorgstream: The genome has been cracked, #fname# has unlocked Vorg! Vorg is tiny healer that will do its best to keep your monsters alive and fighting.
mon_vorgstreambody: Raised and bred by the Brukkarg tribe, these tiny healers will do their best to keep your monsters fighting.
mon_slimeattikusdesc:
An unholy biological terror birthed in the Bangweulu Swamps of Zambia, the Slimeattikus dissolves foes on contact and fissions when attacked.
Favorite Target: Anything
fp_3_18_0: Get a sample of this biological terror and build your own Slimeattikus who will splatter into multiple monsters that will continue to eat away your enemies' yards.
ai_brukkarg_description: Out of nowhere, the Brukkarg attacks! Looks like they enjoy preying on the young and helpless.
ai_brukkarg_succ: It'll be a long time before the Brukkarg Tribe thinks about messing with you again.
ai_brukkarg_succstream: #fname# just destroyed a Brukkarg monster base. They'll think twice before they try to come back into #fname#'s base.
ai_brukkarg_taunt: We're coming in your base to mess up your face!
ai_brukkarg_fail: Your attack failed. Raise a new army and attack them again before they start repairing!

fp_yp2_title: The New Yard Planner: What You Crave
fp_yp2: The wait is over -- the New Yard Planner is coming in hot. Get more tools to make designing a breeze. Create and save templates to change your layout instantly. Check it out and see what the fuss is about.
fp_event_kothpromo1_desc: Power doesn't come easy in the Backyard Universe. It's born in blood and the heat of battle. A new Champion Monster known as Krallen, is on the hunt for a master. He answers only to the best. Prove yourself on June 11.
fp_event_kothpromo2_desc: Krallen craves power, and nothing is a bigger lure to him than loot. He loves wreaking havoc to obtain it, and he loves hoarding it. Want to win his devotion? It's all about the loot on June 11. Greed is good.
fp_event_kothpromo3_desc: Krallen loves a bloodthirsty master almost as much as he loves loot. Impress him by meeting a killer quota. Attract him with your ruthlessness in battle, keep him by staying on top of your game. Are you ready for June 11?
fp_event_kothstart_desc: Attack and loot as many Yards as you can to hit your quota. Once you win Krallen's approval, you'll have to fight to keep his attention. Lose your loot, and you lose his favor. Earn his loyalty now!
fp_event_kothpromo1mr1_desc: Power doesn't come easy in the Backyard Universe. It's born in the heat of battle. A new Champion Monster, Krallen, is on the hunt for a master. He answers only to the best. To participate and prove yourself on June 11, upgrade to Map Room 2.
fp_event_kothpromo2mr1_desc: Nothing is a bigger lure to Krallen than loot. He loves wreaking havoc to obtain it, and he loves hoarding it. Want to win his devotion? It's all about the loot on June 11. Upgrade to Map Room 2 and start wreaking havoc. Greed is good.
fp_event_kothpromo3mr1_desc: Upgrade to Map Room 2 and meet a killer quota to impress Krallen. Get him with your ruthlessness in battle, keep him by staying on top of your game. Are you ready for June 11?
fp_event_kothstartmr1_desc: Want a chance to win Krallen's approval? Upgrade to Map Room 2 to begin attacking and looting as many Yards as possible to hit an inspiring quota. Lose your loot, and you lose his favor. Upgrade now!
msg_stopconstructionoutpostbuilding: You cannot stop the construction of a building in your Outposts.
krallen_desc:
Hunt for Krallen:
Krallen is quite particular about who wields the power -- he only obeys top looters. Hit your resource looting quota each week to keep him happy, or he'll leave you for the next powerful player he can find. Impress him by going above and beyond with your looting, and he'll learn a special ability. Hold him for consecutive weeks, and he'll only grow stronger and more rabid for loot.
mon_krallendesc: Born in the blood-soaked grasslands of southeast Asia, Krallen can survive in any climate - wet or dry. He thinks only of his next kill.
krallen_nogcage: You must build a Champion Cage if you want to participate in the Hunt for Krallen
msg_recycle_mr2krallen: Are you sure you want to recycle?
msg_krallen_nomr2: You must upgrade your Map Room to Level 2 if you want to participate in the Hunt for Krallen
krallen_lootbuff_tooltip: Loot Buff: Krallen buffs nearby monsters' ability to loot. Loot #v1# resources this week to unlock.
krallen_lootbuffactive_tooltip: Loot Buff: Krallen buffs nearby monsters' ability to loot.
fp_kothendwin: Congratulations! You've gained a worthy ally. Hold onto your loot to take advantage of this savage Champion Monster. The longer you maintain your quota, the greater his abilities grow.
fp_kothendlose_title: If At First You Don't Succeed...
fp_kothendlose: Krallen will not be won so easily. With a little luck and some monster blood, you can draw him to your side. Regroup, build your monster army and make it your mission to keep hitting your quota. Your time will come.
fp_kothendkeep: Congratulations! You've impressed Krallen and he's decided to stick around for another week. He's now level #v1#.
fp_kothendlosekrallen: Krallen's loyalty follows the loot -- he's left you to pursue more powerful players. Regroup, attack without mercy, keep hitting your quota, and he'll come back to you.
fp_krallenrisk: The clock's ticking, and you're dangerously close to losing Krallen's devotion. Beef up your army and spill some monster blood. You have less than a day to hit your loot quota before Krallen abandons you in search of greener pastures.
fp_krallenwin: You've put on a bloody good show -- Krallen is taking notice. The loot quota is within reach -- crush your enemies, continue looting, and Krallen will be yours!
fp_kothquota1_havekrallen: Congratulations! You've convinced this savage Champion Monster you're worthy of his service -- he'll stick around for another week. Return to your Yard on Monday to make use of your very own Level #v1# Krallen.
fp_kothquota1_nokrallen: Congratulations! Krallen begins his service on Monday. Keep meeting your quota to stay in his good graces -- the longer you keep hitting your quota, the greater his abilities grow.
fp_kothquota2_title: Krallen's a Team Player -- For the Right Price
fp_kothquota2: Krallen's a giver -- you've impressed him with your power and now he's ready to return the favor by buffing all nearby monsters' ability to loot.
bdg_dave_trophy_desc: You're a a proud member of the D.A.V.E. Club -- display your statue and brag to your friends.

fp_promodaveclub: Ready to up your game? Join the D.A.V.E. Club now to experience a new standard of monstrous excellence. Perks that await you include extra Shiny each month, exclusive Yard skin customizations and 8 additional Yard Planner save slots!

fp_townhall10: Having trouble fending off pesky attackers? Upgrade your Under Hall to Level 10! Beef up your defenses with more Blocks, more Heavy and Booby Traps, higher Level Defensive Towers and a higher Level Monster Bunker.
th_upgradeth10_msg: You may need to takeover more Outposts in Map Room 2 or purchase Improved Packing Skills in the Store to increase your resource capacity.
fp_promodaveclub2: Backyard real estate is booming! D.A.V.E. Club members now receive an additional eight save slots in their Yard Planner. Still not a member?
fp_event_bruwarpromo2: The bloodthirsty Brukkarg Tribe have been watching you and plotting their first strike. Do away with your attackers and you'll be handsomely rewarded.
fp_event_bruwarpromo3: They've been watching you, and now the time has finally come - are you ready for battle? The Brukkarg War begins tomorrow! Fight for what's yours, outlast the enemy, and the new Spurtz Cannon is yours!
fp_event_bruwarfinal_title: Can You Mess With The Best?
event_bruwarreward1_streamdesc: Monster corpses make nice Yard decorations.
event_bruwarreward2_streamtitle: #fname# Won A Second Spurtz Cannon in Backyard Monsters!
event_bruwarreward2_streamdesc: It's a Backyard battlefield - and these lethal twins don't miss!
event_bruwarreward3_streamtitle: #fname# Won Two Black Diamond Spurtz Cannons in Backyard Monsters!
event_bruwarreward3_streamdesc: Don't come too close if you like your head attached to your body!
fp_event_bruwarpromo1: Once thought to be extinct, the Brukkarg Wild Monster Tribe is coming to destroy you! Fortify your Yard and ready your monster militia - bloodshed is seven days away!
fp_bruwarreward1: The Spurtz Cannon is yours! Three rounds down, just two more to go! Make the Brukkarg Tribe pay!
bi_spurtzcannon_desc: Your very own Backyard shotgun! This Cannon fires a Spurtz militia to do your bidding - just what you need to stop groups of invaders dead in their tracks.
bi_blackspurtzcannon_desc: The Black Diamond Spurtz Cannon boasts stronger durability and reduced reloading times. Your enemies will need a monster miracle to get past these!
fp_event_bruwarbruwarattack4: You're almost there! It's now or never. Take this yard for all it's worth and show the Brukkargs they've challenged the wrong monsters!
fp_event_bruwarend: What's left of the Brukkarg assassins have gone back into hiding and your Backyard militia is stronger than ever!
fp_event_bruwarattack: Five waves of Brukkarg troops down! It's time for you to attack. Scare these monster stalkers back where they came from!
fp_event_bruwarreward3_title: Black Diamond is a Monster's Best Friend
event_bruwarreward1_streamtitle: #fname# Won A Spurtz Cannon in Backyard Monsters!
fp_event_bruwarreward3: You rule the Yard! Your new Black Diamond Spurtz Cannons will have your rivals running for the hills!
fp_event_bruwarreward2: Two Spurtz Cannons means double trouble for the next round of Backyard invaders! Keep 'em coming!
fp_event_bruwarreward1: The Spurtz Cannon is yours! Three rounds down, just two more to go! Make the Brukkarg Tribe pay!
fp_event_bruwarfinal: After stalking your every move, the Brukkarg Tribe has completely copied your yard! No one knows your layout better than you - channel your strengths and bury your weaknesses! Attack!
fp_event_bruwarbruwarattack3: 15 waves of predator Brukkargs wasted, just 10 to go! Show no mercy on this Yard and your new Spurtz Cannon will be mowing down monsters in no time!
fp_event_bruwarbruwarattack2: The Backyard battlefield is heating up! Lock and load - it's your move. There's more where that came from!
fp_event_bruwarbruwarattack: Five waves of Brukkarg troops down! It's time for you to attack. Scare these monster stalkers back where they came from!
fp_event_bruwarstart: Fight through five waves of Brukkarg attackers and then exact your coldblooded revenge! Survive all 25 brutal raids and blow your enemies away with five offensives of your own to win two deadly Black Diamond Spurtz Cannons!
fp_wotcpop1: Moloch's favorite Inferno pet, Korath, is on a rampage! He's developed an undeniable hunger for Putty, and has been tearing through Outposts to get his share. Are you powerful enough to control him? You'll have to find him first!
fp_wotcpop2: Korath can't be stopped! He loves chaos almost as much as he loves Putty. Your Outpost could be next! You'll need to track him down, capture him, and use him in your monster militia. Think you're ready for the hunt?
fp_wotcpop3: Korath's Putty tear has taken the World Map by storm. Countless Outposts are destroyed, and Putty supplies are depleted. Hunt Korath down and make him one of your own before he goes too far. Monster Madness begins tomorrow. Good luck!
fp_wotcstart: It's time to tame the mighty Korath! Take over as many Outposts as you can, gaining points toward this Champion with each assault. Korath will serve you loyally as long as you supply him a steady diet of Inferno Monsters. Happy hunting!
fp_wotcreward1: Congratulations - Korath is now one of your own! This monster of fire and brimstone will be a very valuable asset to your monster militia. Open the Champion Cage and let your brand new pet do the work from there!
wotcreward1_streambody: Moloch's precious pet is under new ownership. Let the blood and games begin!
fp_wotcreward2: It's heating up! Well done - you've earned Korath's Breath of Fire ability. Your new Champion can now spew fire at any flying monster that dares to come too close. Stay away!
wotcreward2_streamtitle: #fname# unlocked Korath's Breath of Fire in Backyard Monsters.
wotcreward2_streambody: Fire up the grill - Korath's special ability turns flying monsters into barbecue!
fp_wotcreward3: Great job! You've discovered Korath's Fists of Doom! This mighty monster will now punch the ground with his massive knuckles, causing a large tremor that damages everything within range. Hold on!
wotcreward3_streamtitle: #fname# unlocked Korath's Fists of Doom in Backyard Monsters.
wotcreward3_streambody: Safe ground is a thing of the past - Korath's footsteps leave one hell of a wake.
fp_wotcend: Korath's rampage could only last for so long! With Backyard Putty levels at an all time low, the Champion Korath has nowhere else to go. Better catch him next time!
tut_1b:

Click Full Screen to view more of your Yard.
fp_wotcpop1live: Moloch's favorite Inferno pet, Korath, is on a rampage! He's developed an undeniable hunger for Putty, and has been tearing through Outposts to get his share. Are you powerful enough to control him? Try your luck starting 8/16!
fp_wotcpop2live: Korath can't be stopped! He loves chaos almost as much as he loves Putty. Your Outpost could be next! You'll need to track him down, capture him, and use him in your monster militia. The hunt begins 8/16 - think you're ready?
fp_wotcpop3live: Korath's Putty tear has taken the World Map by storm. Countless Outposts are destroyed, and Putty supplies are depleted. Hunt Korath down and make him one of your own before he goes too far. Monster Madness begins tomorrow. Good luck!

mh_inferno_trans_txt: Inferno Transfer: Transfer monsters from your Inferno base into your housing.
mh_juicing_txt: Juice Monsters: Juice selected monsters from your housing.
tut_NWM_Step_2: This is the Backyard Monsters World Map. Your main yard is surrounded by Wild Monsters. Let's take back one of their outposts. Click on the Legionnaire Tribe outpost next to your yard.
tut_NWM_Step_3: Now that you've selected this Wild Monster base, click Attack/Scout to scout their base.
tut_NWM_Step_4:
You are now viewing the Wild Monster base. 

It looks like they have no defenses. 

Click Attack to begin your assault.
tut_NWM_Step_5:
On the left you can see the Pokeys you have in your housing. Click the ' ' icon to add them to the flinger.

Click and hold ' ' to add at least 15 Pokeys to the Flinger.
tut_NWM_Step_6:
Good, now select where you want to fling your monsters. 

You can't fling monsters too close to buildings, so make sure the drop zone circle is white before you click it.
tut_NWM_Step_7: Congratulations, you leveled their entire backyard base!
tut_NWM_Step_8:
Adding Wild Monster outposts to your empire changes the color of the light on each outpost you conquer.

Buildings with Blue Lights show that you own that part of the map.

Click Next to Continue.
tut_NWM_Step_9:
When you conquer a Wild Monster Outpost surrounding your Main Yard, it fortifies your Main Yard. 

Conquer all 6 surrounding outposts to maximize your defense. 

Click Next to Continue
tut_NWM_Step_10:
Cells shaded in Blue are within your Flicker range.  

You can attack anywhere within your range for free. 

Click Next to continue.
tut_NWM_Step_11:
Cells NOT shaded in Blue are outside your Flicker range.  

You can still attack these cells, but it will cost resources to do so. 

Click End to conclude the tutorial.
mr3_bookmarks_full_message: You cannot have more than #v1# bookmarks. Please delete one of your bookmarks before adding another.
tut_NWM_Step2: Wild Monsters are preparing to attack your yard. You need to build defenses. Let's build a sniper tower to protect your yard. Click on the Buildings menu.
tut_NWM_Step3: Here you can browse the different buildings you can add to your yard. Click on the Defensive buildings tab.
tut_NWM_Step5: Here you can see the description, requirements and cost of the Sniper Tower. Click Build.
tut_NWM_Step6: Build the sniper tower in your yard by clicking on the grass.
tut_NWM_Step7: Click on the Sniper Tower and select Speed Up.
tut_NWM_Step8: Buy "Close Enough" to finish the upgrade instantly. The Close Enough speed up is free for upgrades with #cm# minutes or less remaining.
tut_NWM_Step9: Your Sniper Tower is complete and will now fire on any intruders that try to attack your base. Collect your reward!
tut_NWM_Step10: WHOA! Just in time, here come some Wild Monsters Don't worry, the Sniper Tower should make quick work of them, just sit back and watch the action.
tut_NWM_Step11: Oooh, looks like you completed a rather bloody quest for defending your yard. Don't forget to collect the reward by clicking on the completed Quest.
tut_NWM_Step12: That attack came from the nearby Legionnaire Wild Monster Tribe. Let's strike back before they get a chance to build up a larger attack!
tut_NWM_Step13: The first thing we need to do is build housing for your monster army. Click on the Buildings menu.
tut_NWM_Step17:
Place it somewhere in your yard. 

You can click and drag to move the yard around to find space.
tut_NWM_Step18: Select your Monster Housing then click on Speed Up.
tut_NWM_Step20:
We've recruited some Pokeys to help. Pokeys are a little slow and small but what they lack in strength the make up for in numbers!

Collect your reward now.
tut_NWM_Step21: Now let's build a flinger so we can fling our Pokeys into the enemy backyard. Click on the Buildings menu.
tut_NWM_Step24: Place it somewhere in your backyard (remember, you can click and drag to find space).
tut_NWM_Step25: Select your Flinger and then click "Speed Up".
tut_NWM_Step26: Since your Flinger takes more than 5 minutes to build, let's buy the "Finish Building NOW" speed up.
tut_NWM_Step27: Now let's build a map room so you find those Legionnaires and counter attack.
tut_NWM_Step30: Place the Map Room in your back yard.
tut_NWM_Step31: Now speed up the completion of your Map Room in the same way you did the Flinger.
tut_NWM_Step33: Now let's use the Map Room to find the Wild Monster Tribe that attacked you and strike back with your Pokey Army! Click on the Map menu.
tut_NWM_Step34:
This is the Backyard Monsters World Map. 

Your main yard is surrounded by Wild Monsters. Let's tack back one of their outposts. 

Click on the Legionnaire Tribe outpost next to your yard.
tut_NWM_Step36: You are now viewing the Wild Monster Base. It looks like they have no defenses. Click Attack to begin your assault.
tut_NWM_Step37:
On the left you can see the pokeys you have in your housing. Press the ' ' icon to add them to the Flinger.

Click and hold ' ' to add at least 10 to the Flinger.
tut_NWM_Step38: Good, now select where you want to fling them. You can't fling monsters too close to buildings, so make sure the drop zone circle is white before you click it.
tut_NWM_Step39: I bet they wish they had defenses now!
tut_NWM_Step41: Build a hatchery to start producing monsters! Click on the Buildings menu.
tut_NWM_Step45: Place the hatchery somewhere in your yard.
tut_NWM_Step46: Don't forget to Speed Up the construction of the Hatchery.
tut_NWM_Step48: Now that your Hatchery is ready, try turning some Goo into monsters. Click on the Hatchery and select View Hatchery.
tut_NWM_Step49: Click on Pokey to add it to the production queue. You can click on it several times to add more than one.
tut_NWM_Step50:
Good Work!

When you are done close the Hatchery.
tut_NWM_Step51: Unlocking Monsters and keeping your Hatchery in production requires Putty and Goo. Let's build some Putty and Goo Harvesters. Click on the Buildings menu.
tut_NWM_Step55: Now, place it in your back yard.
tut_NWM_Step56: Now build a Goo Factory. Click on the Buildings menu.
tut_NWM_Step59: Now, place it in your back yard.
tut_NWM_Step60: Nice job! Your backyard base is now ready for action! Try upgrading your Under Hall to unlock better buildings.
tut_NWM_Step61: Also build the "Monster Locker" and unlock new monsters.
tut_NWM_Step62: While this counter is here other players can't attack you.
tut_NWM_Step63:
Check the Quests like to see what you should be doing next to collect rewards.

Good luck!

nwm_confirm_force: Welcome to the New World Map for a whole new level of strategic gameplay! Control Strongholds and Resource Outposts, improve your defenses, and attack anywhere on the Map.
prize_description_rezghul: Introducing Rezghul - the Backyard resurrector! This mighty monster can bring fellow monsters back from the dead at will, making Rezghul the perfect addition to any Backyard barrage.
prize_description_spurtz_cannon_1: Your very own Backyard shotgun! This Cannon fires a Spurtz militia to do your bidding - just what you need to stop groups of invaders dead in their tracks.
prize_description_spurtz_cannon_bd: The Black Diamond Spurtz Cannon boasts stronger durability and reduced reloading times. Your enemies will need a monster miracle to get past these!
prize_description_unlock_vorg: Hatched in giant hives deep inside the asteroid belt, Vorg are flying alien healers with a penchant for mischief.
prize_description_unlock_slimeattikus: An unholy biological terror birthed in the Bangweulu Swamps of Zambia, the Slimeattikus dissolves foes on contact and fissions when attacked.
prize_description_korath: Spawned in the magma pits of Inferno, Korath uses his massive body and fiery core to eliminate enemies.
prize_description_korath_ability_1: This Champion from the depths of Inferno has special abilities, like the Breath of Fire. This attack enables him to spit fiery orbs at aerial monsters.
prize_description_korath_ability_2: Korath's other special ability is called the Fists of Doom. Korath slams both fists into the ground, creating an earthquake-like effect that damages everything close enough to feel the tremor.
mon_rezghul: This mighty monster can bring fellow monsters back from the dead at will, making Rezghul the perfect addition to any Backyard barrage.
prize_locked_spurtz_cannon_2: You must purchase one Spurtz Cannon before you can purchase a second one.

prize_locked_korath_ability_1: You must purchase Korath to unlock  Breath of Fire.
prize_locked_korath_ability_2: You must purchase Korath's Breath of Fire ability to unlock his Fists of Doom ability.
msg_err_nocells: No open cells near user! Try another world.
fp_hellraiserspop1: There's something eerie happening in the New World Map. A brand new monster resident, Rezghul, has been popping up in places you'd least expect. It seems wherever he goes, chaos ensues. Think you can tame him? Prove it March 21st!
prize_description_spurtz_cannon_2: The more firepower the better! Man your Backyard defenses with double the Spurtz Cannons and watch invading monsters run for the hills!
event_store: Introducing the Event Store! Your spot to spend the points you've earned throughout Hellraisers. The mighty Rezghul, and prizes from past events, will all be up for grabs. The Event Store will be open for the duration of Hellraisers and will end 24 hours after the event ends. Best of luck!
fp_hellraiserspop2: We need your help! Rezghul has begun reanimating fallen monsters and is turning the New World Map into a disaster area! You must destroy all Inferno yards in sight before the mighty Rezghul gets his way. Will you be ready March 21st?
fp_hellraiserspop3: Rezghul's rampage hasn't let up! He's leaving a wake of reanimated monsters in his path. Someone must stop the chaos on the New World Map before it's too late! Hellraisers starts March 21st - get ready for action!
fp_hellraisersstart: It's time to tame the mystical Rezghul! Destroy all Inferno yards you can get your hands on. Remember - the higher level of the yard, the more points you'll win. Create enough chaos and Rezghul could be yours. Good luck!
fp_hellraisersend: Great work! You've destroyed countless Inferno yards and the New World Map is safe once again. Did you unlock the mighty Rezghul?
fp_heallraiserspop1_upgrade: Inferno yards are about to pop up everywhere - we need your help! Hellraisers begins March 21st. Upgrade to the New World Map now so you don't miss out!

hfo_event_desc: Something is wrong in the Inferno. The fires are dimming, and ice is creeping across your yard...
bi_icepatch_desc: A patch of ice. In the Inferno. That can't be good.
hfo_ice_small_msg1: F#@k. I hope hell's not freezing over again.
hfo_ice_small_msg2: Ice? Down here? That's never a good sign.
hfo_ice_small_msg3: Last time this happened, nobody got paid for a thousand years.
hfo_ice_small_msg4: Who left the door to the frozen wastes open?!
hfo_ice_small_msg5: Brr. I did NOT sign up for this.
hfo_ice_small_msg6: S#!t, my pick's stuck... nope, got it.
bi_icepatch_big_desc: This ice won't break. Something old is behind it. Send a worker to try each patch once.
hfo_ice_big_msg1: Just like 10,000 eons ago. I can't break the curse.
hfo_ice_big_msg2: D@mn thing won't even chip. It's the old curse, I know it.
hfo_ice_big_msg3: My pick shattered! This isn't normal ice...
hfo_ice_big_msg4: Somebody get the boss. It's happening again.
hfo_ice_big_msg5: This ice is cursed. I'm not touching it again.
hfo_tower_frozen_desc: This tower is sealed in ice. Send a worker to break it free.
hfo_ice_tower_msg1: One down. How many more of these frozen b@$#ards are there?
hfo_ice_tower_msg3: Cold enough to freeze the horns off a Balthazar.
hfo_ice_tower_msg4: Keep the fire lit, boys, we're getting it back.
bi_iceprison_desc: A huge block of ancient ice. Something inside it is very, very cold.
hfo_tomb_msg: That's not ice. That's a tomb.
hfo_pop_frozen_body:
The curse has returned and the Inferno's fires are dying. Ice cretins are pouring out of the frozen wastes.

Eliminate the waves of ice cretins to restore heat to the Inferno.
hfo_pop_wave_won_body: The Inferno grows a little warmer. You earned #v1# Shiny.
hfo_pop_wave_won_replay_body: The Inferno grows a little warmer. The ice around the tomb is weakening.
hfo_pop_wave_failed_body: The ice cretins broke through. You have #v1# tries left on this wave.
hfo_pop_wave_skipped_body: You're out of tries for this wave, so it has been skipped. You can replay it later to break the curse, but it won't pay Shiny.
hfo_pop_final_body: You've beaten Wave 13 and earned #v1# Shiny!
hfo_banner_weakening: The ice is weakening... replay skipped waves to break the curse.
hfo_pop_champion_body: The curse is broken, and something was waiting in the ice. Rimegrave can now be unlocked in the Strongbox.
hfo_wave_skipped: Skipped - replay to break the curse
mi_Shivling_desc: A tiny imp of living ice that never travels alone. Shivlings swarm in packs and soak up tower fire. Its hits ice over towers and freeze monsters. Favorite Target: Anything
mi_Slushgut_desc: A bloated, waddling mound of slush with ice tusks and a hide that shrugs off damage. Slow, but very hard to stop. Its hits ice over towers and freeze monsters. Favorite Target: Anything
mi_Rimeclaw_desc: A lean ice raptor with scythe claws made for tearing defenses apart. It ignores everything else. Its hits ice over towers and freeze monsters. Favorite Target: Defenses
mi_Sleetwing_desc: A frost bat with crystal-boned wings. It flies straight over walls. Its hits ice over towers and freeze monsters. Favorite Target: Anything
mi_Hailspitter_desc: A frostbitten toad with a crystal mortar growing out of its back. It lobs hailstones over walls from a distance. Its hits ice over towers and freeze monsters. Favorite Target: Defenses
mi_Permafrosthulk_desc: A knuckle-walking glacier brute. Slow, and it hits like an avalanche. When it falls it shatters into Shivlings. Its hits ice over towers and freeze monsters. Favorite Target: Anything
mi_Rimegrave_desc: Sealed in ice by the Inferno 10,000 eons ago, Rimegrave is the source of the curse. His hits ice over towers and freeze monsters solid, and his crystal antlers grow larger with every Academy level. Favorite Target: Anything
mi_Rimegrave_streambody: The Inferno's ancient ice champion has a new master.
mon_strongbox_hfo_locked: Break the curse in Hell Freezes Over to unlock Rimegrave.

bdg_fmitotem1_desc: Won by holding off the Frozen Monster Invasion 1. It grows when you win waves 10, 20, 30, 31 and 32.
bdg_fmitotem2_desc: Won by holding off the Frozen Monster Invasion 2. It grows when you win waves 10, 20, 30, 31 and 32.
bdg_gauntlet_trophy_desc: Won by breaking all 13 gates of Moloch's Gauntlet.
bdg_gauntlet_nocat_desc: Won by breaking all 13 gates of Moloch's Gauntlet in one month without firing a single catapult.
bdg_sign_desc: A free sign from the D.A.V.E. Club. Write a message on it (up to 80 letters): everyone who looks at your yard can click it and read it.
bdg_io_cauldron_desc: An iron cauldron over a crackling fire, its green brew forever bubbling. Nobody knows what's in it. Nobody asks.
bdg_io_chained_imp_desc: A little imp chained to a post, hopping about and rattling his chain. He'd like a word with whoever put him there.
bdg_io_lava_fountain_desc: An obsidian fountain that leaps with lava instead of water. Do not throw coins in. They melt.
bdg_io_soul_lantern_desc: An iron lantern swinging from its post, a blue soul-flame writhing inside. It lights the way for the lost.
bdg_io_brazier_desc: A tall iron brazier of leaping hellfire, embers flying. Cosy.
bdg_io_skull_totem_desc: Three skulls on a pole, their eyes aglow. The top one keeps looking round. Always watching.
bdg_io_pendulum_desc: A crescent blade swinging between two stone posts. Mind your head.
bdg_io_ember_geyser_desc: A cracked mound of rock that breathes out puffs of glowing embers.
bdg_io_abyss_eye_desc: An eye on a fleshy stalk that looks all around your yard, and blinks. It sees everything.
bdg_io_spit_roast_desc: A great drumstick turning slowly on a spit over the fire. Smells like victory.
bdg_io_bat_vane_desc: A bat on a weathervane, turning with the hot winds of the Inferno and flapping its wings.
bdg_io_magma_wheel_desc: Lava pours from a stone chute and turns a wooden wheel. What it powers is a mystery.
bdg_io_tentacle_pit_desc: Something lives down in this glowing pit. Only its tentacle comes up to sway about.
bdg_io_alliance_banner_desc: Your alliance's shield on a crimson banner, for everyone who visits to see. It shows whatever shield your alliance has at the time.
bi_td2_obelisk_desc: Hellgate Defense 2: chills everything round it, slowing them and dealing a little damage.
bi_td2_venom_desc: Hellgate Defense 2: venom that stacks five deep and eats through armour.
bi_td2_drum_desc: Hellgate Defense 2: towers round it hit harder and faster.
bi_td2_shrine_desc: Hellgate Defense 2: gold every wave, and kills near it pay more.
bi_td2_catapult_desc: Hellgate Defense 2: huge range, huge hits that splash; ground only.
bi_td2_roost_desc: Hellgate Defense 2: gargoyles that tear fliers out of the sky.
mi_Basilisk_desc: A spined serpent that slithers over walls, coils round its prey and squeezes eight times a second. Double damage to monsters. Point at a building in an attack to send him there first.
mi_Basilisk_stream: #fname# was joined by the Basilisk in Backyard Monsters: Inferno.
mi_Basilisk_streambody: It watched a hundred battles. Then it chose a side.
emerge_mondesc_mi_Basilisk_desc: Red and black coils, spines down his back, eyes like embers. Favorite Target: Anything (the building you point at first)
io_qd_basilisk: Something has been watching you fight. Win battle after battle, and in time it may decide to fight at your side.
io_worker_busy_away: All your workers are busy picking warts or breaking ice. They'll be back in a moment.
io_worker_busy_free: All your workers are busy. Your #v1# is done in #v2#: select it to finish it for free.
io_worker_busy_next: All your workers are busy. The first one is free when your #v1# is done in #v2#, or finish it now for #v3# Shiny.
io_juice_confirm: Juice #v1#? You get up to #v2# Magma (a wounded monster gives less). This can't be undone.
io_cloc_recycle_unlocking: Your Strongbox is unlocking #v1#. Cancel the unlock first (its full cost comes back), then you can recycle it.
io_kit_warning: This replaces this outpost's #v1# buildings with the kit (the hall stays).
io_kit_warning_housed: Your #v1# housed monsters stay if the kit's Compounds have room for them; any that don't fit are lost.
io_takeover_noanswer: The server didn't answer. The map is checking whether the takeover went through: look at the yard again before trying once more.
io_kit_failed: The kit couldn't be built: the server didn't answer. You've already paid for it: press Try again to build it (you won't be charged twice).
io_kit_failed_reason: The kit couldn't be built: #v1# You've already paid for it: press Try again to build it once that's sorted (you won't be charged twice).
io_mail_no_answer: Your message may not have been sent: the server didn't answer. It's still in the box, so you can send it again.
io_kits_load_failed: Your saved kits couldn't be loaded just now. Close the kits and open them again to try once more.
io_hfo_later_note: Start wave 1 whenever you are ready: press the event's icon in the top bar.
io_result_not_saved: The wave's result could not reach the server. Try again before you leave this yard, or the wave counts as lost.
io_purist_ask:
Fire the catapult?

One catapult shot in Moloch's Gauntlet ends your chance at the Purist Trophy (all 13 gates with no catapult) for this month.
io_invite_tip:
Invite Friends
Share your invite link: you both get #v1# Shiny.
io_repair_desc: Instantly repair the #v1# damaged buildings in this yard now (repairs under #v2# are free).
io_leave_ask:
Leave the Inferno?

Your yard is saved; you can come back any time.
io_welcome_new_body: Build your yard, hatch monsters and raid the tribes around you. The Quest Book shows you where to start, step by step, and pays you for each step.
io_outposts_healed: The wounded defenders of #v1# outposts are healed.
io_outposts_heal_busy: #v1# being attacked now were left as they are.
io_outposts_heal_failed: The outposts could not be healed. Please try again.
io_portal_needs_range: To attack down there, one of your yards needs this portal in its Flinger range.
io_portal_nearest: To attack down there: your nearest yard, at #v1#, is #v2# cells away, and its Flinger reaches #v3# (Declare War adds 2).
io_portal_nearest_noflinger: To attack down there: your nearest yard, at #v1#, is #v2# cells away, and it has no Flinger yet.
io_planner_save_failed: The plan wasn't saved. Please try again.
io_planner_undone: Undone: every building is back where it was.
io_planner_undo_blocked: Something now stands where a building was, so it can't all go back. Move it, then try Undo again.
io_hfo_hud_cursed: Cursed ice tried: #v1# / #v2# (try each patch once)
io_hfo_hud_daydone_at: Done for today. The next day begins on your first visit after #v1#.
io_hfo_hud_daydone: Done for today. The next day begins the next time you come home.
io_hfo_day1_body:
Ice. In the Inferno. Patches of it are forming in your yard.

Click each one to send a worker to break it: 12 in all, a few now and one more every two hours.
io_hfo_day2_body:
Five great patches of cursed ice have come up, and they won't break.

Send a worker to try each one once. A patch already tried says so.
io_hfo_day3_body:
The ground has frozen, and every defence tower is sealed in ice.

Click each frozen tower to send a worker to free it. (They still fire if you're attacked.)
io_hatch_fill_tip: Shift-click: as many as there's room and Magma for (#v1#).
io_hatch_fill_none: No room for more: the Compound is full (counting the monsters queued), or there isn't enough Magma.
io_planner_unplaced:
This plan doesn't place every building.

Not on it (built since it was saved, most often): #v1#.

Place them on the plan, or keep them where they stand in your yard now.
io_end_attack_ask:
End the attack?

#v1# monsters and #v2# are left.
io_end_attack_gauntlet: It uses one of this stage's attempts.
io_exh_ending:
Extra Housing ends in #v1#.

Your Compound will then have #v2# less room than its monsters take. Fling or juice some first, or the extra will be let go (from the kinds you have most of).
io_exh_culled: The Compound is short of room (Extra Housing ended, or a Compound is down), so these were let go: #v1#.
io_takeover_cost: Taking it over: #v1# of each resource
io_takeover_cost_short: Taking it over: #v1# of each resource (you're short)
io_takeover_cap: You have the most outposts you can have: it can't be taken over.
io_gauntlet_open_notice: Moloch's Gauntlet is open until #v1# (your time): #v2# gates left.
io_bloom_about:
Wart Bloom

Warts grow #v1# times as fast in your main yard until #v2# (your time), #v3# from now. Offline time counts too.

io_alliance_request_words: A few words to the leader (optional): who you are, why this alliance.

io_tot_tip_trick: A trick from #v1#! Their Zagnoids are on the way.
io_tot_tip_open: #v1# doors left to knock on · ends in #v2#
io_tot_home_only: Knock on the doors from your own main yard.
io_tot_busy: Not now: finish what's going on in your yard first.
io_tot_load_fail: The doors didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
io_tot_over: Trick or Treat is over for this year. See you next Halloween!
io_tot_trick_coming: #v2# Zagnoids from #v1# surround your yard in #v3#…
io_tot_trick_goal: Destroy every one of the #v1# and you get your #v2# Shiny after all!
io_tot_bar: TRICK! Destroy all #v1# Zagnoids for #v2# Shiny
io_tot_result_won: TREAT AFTER ALL! You destroyed all #v1# Zagnoids from #v2#. +#v3# Shiny!
io_tot_result_lost: TRICKED! You destroyed #v1# of the #v2# Zagnoids, and #v3# got away with what they took.
io_tot_left: You left during the trick: the Zagnoids from #v1# got away.
io_tot_gift: Trick or Treat is over! For knocking on the doors, #v1# Mini-Pumpkins are waiting in your storage (Buildings, Decorations).
io_tot_still_coming: Don't think they forgot: the trick from #v1# is coming!
io_tot_intro: Knock once on each wild tribe's door. Behind it: a treat of #v1# Shiny… or a trick: #v2# level #v3# Zagnoids all round your yard. Destroy every one of them and the treat is yours after all. They take real loot!
io_tot_foot: Everyone who knocks gets #v1# Mini-Pumpkins once Trick or Treat is over.
io_tot_wait_trick: First the trick from #v1#: destroy their Zagnoids, then knock on the next door.
io_auth_typo:
Did you mean #v2#?

You typed #v1#. Your account logs in with this address, so check it.
io_welcome_email: You log in with #v1#: note it down.
io_switch_ask:
Switch account?

Your yard is saved first. You go back to the login page to sign in as someone else.
io_saved_expired: Your saved login ran out (unused for #v1# days): type your password.
io_saved_ended: Your saved login was ended (a password change or a sign-out): type your password.
io_planner_load_ask:
Load another plan?

This plan has changes that aren't saved. Loading another replaces them.
io_powerup_ask:
Activate #v1#?

It works for #v2# for every member, then takes #v3# to charge again.
io_move_main_ask:
Move your main yard to this outpost (#v1#)?

The outpost and every building on it are destroyed, and your main yard takes its place. Wild monsters claim your old spot. This can't be undone.
io_invite_progress: Friends who joined through your link: #v1# (#v2# paid).
io_invite_waiting: #v1# haven't played yet: the Shiny comes when they first load the game.
io_invite_none: No friends have joined through your link yet.
io_arcade_leave_ask:
Leave the game?

io_who_hide_failed: Couldn't change how you appear: try again in a moment.
io_bookmark_failed: Your bookmarks weren't saved: the server didn't answer.
io_replay_gone: This replay is no longer on the server (replays are kept for a while, then removed).
io_replay_dl_failed: The replay couldn't be downloaded right now. Try again in a moment.
io_keys_list:
Keys
Arrows or W A S D: move + -: zoom H: Under Hall
B: Build P: Planner T: Store M: Map Q: Quests
C: bank all F: full screen Esc: close

io_pit_rules_asc2: It reaches #v1# after 10 seconds and #v2# after 20, until a Sharpshooter Tower shoots Balthazar down.
io_pit_rules_asc3: CASH OUT before that for your bet times the multiplier. Still aboard when he is shot down: the bet is lost.
io_pit_rules_asc4: AUTO CASH-OUT AT (#v1# or more) cashes out exactly there; by hand, the server's clock decides.
io_pit_rules_asc5: Where he is shot down is drawn from the round's seed: it can be at once, at 1.00x.
io_pit_rules_dice1: Up to #v1# players at a table; the Devil throws the same two bones for all of them.
io_pit_rules_dice2: Bet while bets are open. Each throw without the Devil's face raises the multiplier: #v1#
io_pit_rules_dice3: BANK between throws for your bet times the multiplier, or set BANK AFTER (1 to #v1# throws).
io_pit_rules_dice4: When the Devil's face comes up, whatever is still on the table is his.
io_pit_rules_dice5: Every bet is against the house: nothing moves between players.

io_pit_rules_derby2: While bets are open, choose a chip and click runners on the board, then PLACE BET.
io_pit_rules_derby3: If your monster wins, you get your bet times its odds (your bet included); bets on the others are lost.
io_pit_rules_derby4: You can bet on several runners, and place more than once, before the race starts.
io_pit_rules_derby5: The lower the odds, the likelier the win.

io_acc_maphelp_1:
Drag the map to move it. Zoom with the + and - buttons on the window's top edge, the mouse wheel or a pinch: five steps, from the whole world (World, World 2x and World 4x) to Far and Close.

The minimap at the top right shows the whole world: click or drag in it to go there. Back returns to where you were before your last jump, and Recent lists the places you looked at.

Keys: the arrows move, + and - zoom, H goes home, B adds a bookmark and F opens Find.
io_acc_maphelp_2:
In the sidebar, Home takes you back to your main yard and Jump to the X and Y you type.

Find a player: type part of a name to see every player on this world who matches, with their alliance, main yard and outposts, each with Go.

Bookmarks: add one from a yard's window or from an empty place's bubble. Each shows what is there now and how far it is from your nearest yard; sort them, give them a colour, rename or remove them. Share in chat sends a place to Global or Alliance chat as a link that opens the map there.
io_acc_maphelp_3:
Filters (the funnel button on the window's top edge) choose whose yards show (yours, your alliance's, friendly, hostile and the rest), main yards or outposts, and what the world map draws: your flinger range, your bookmarks and damaged tribe yards. Its Targets column leaves out yards by level, protected or locked yards, or yards out of your flinger range, faded or hidden.

Targets (on the top edge too) lists every yard your flingers reach, with its level, damage, protection and distance: Go takes you there, Attack opens it ready to attack.
io_acc_maphelp_4:
You can attack yards inside the range of your yards' Flingers (blue on the world map). Destroy 90% of a tribe's yard or of a player's outpost and you can take it over as your own outpost; a Starter Kit builds it at once.

On the world map and the minimap, damaged tribe yards are orange and those ready to take over red. A yard with damage protection can't be attacked until it runs out.
io_acc_maphelp_5:
Outposts add resources to your main yard (once you have opened each one), hatch and house monsters, and their Flingers reach further.

The Outposts list (the top bar's Next outpost button) shows them all: sort by any column, show only those that need attention, open one with View or find it with Map, and give each one a name. The sidebar's Outposts tab lists them by name, each with Go.
io_acc_maphelp_6:
Below the world lie the Depths of Hell: an island of 10 x 10 cells in a sea of lava. Portals (the light purple dots on the world map and the minimap) sit in the biggest lava pools: click one, or Depths under Home and Jump, to go down.

A yard of yours with a portal in its Flinger range can attack the cells next to the portal's end down there. In the Depths an outpost reaches only the cells next to it, and one next to a portal reaches the world above up to 5 cells around the portal. Taking over down there costs twice as much, and main yards can't move there. The sidebar's Portals tab lists every portal.
io_acc_maphelp_7:
Relocate (in the sidebar, or in your main yard's window on the map) moves your main yard to a new place on the map: all your resources are emptied and your outposts go back to the wild tribes.

You can also move your main yard onto one of your own outposts, or onto an alliance member's outpost when they invite you, for Shiny or resources.

io_t3c_fair_body: A bet's numbers are HMAC-SHA256(server seed, "client seed:nonce:block"), four bytes to a number between 0 and 1. The server seed stays secret while it is in use: you see its SHA-256 hash first, and the seed itself once you change seeds. A win with part of a Shiny (1.5x on 1) pays one more Shiny with that part's chance, decided by the bet's next number.

io_t3a_g_hellgate_text:
Wall a maze with the Yard Planner, buy towers and upgrade them, and hold the Under Hall against endless waves.

Solo: how many waves can you survive?
Versus: two arenas, waves in step. Spend gold to send monsters at your rival. Last Hall standing wins.
Co-op: whatever gets through your maze runs on into your partner's. 20 lives, shared.
io_t3a_g_hellgate2_text:
Twice the Hellgate: 4 maps, 12 towers with a fourth Special upgrade each, spells, elite monsters, bosses with powers and the Hellgate Warden at wave 40.

Campaign: win each map on four difficulties; embers buy Hellforge perks.
Daily: today's map and two modifiers, the same for everyone.
io_t3a_g_hellgate2_touch: Tap. Spells: the buttons over the shop.
io_t3a_g_siege_text:
One yard, one army, the same for everyone. Fling the monsters and wreck as much as you can, as fast as you can. Your own monsters stay home: nothing is lost.

Daily: a new yard every day, 3 tries, your best counts.
Duel: challenge a player to the same yard and army. The better attack wins.
io_t3a_g_wormzer_text:
Steer your King Wormzer round the lava arena and eat embers to grow. Run into another Wormzer's body and you fall apart; make them run into yours.

Solo: you and seven bots.
Live: one arena for everyone online (bots fill the gaps).
io_t3a_g_wormzer_touch: Stick, or a finger on the arena: steer. BOOST: burrow faster.
io_t3a_g_wormzer_keys: Mouse: steer. Hold the button: burrow faster.
io_t3a_g_fusebug_text:
Drop Fusebugs, blow the bone crates apart for power-ups (more Fusebugs, bigger blasts, faster feet) and blast your rivals. Last one standing wins; after two minutes the lava closes in.

Solo: against three bots.
Live: two to four players (bots fill the corners).
io_t3a_g_fusebug_touch: Stick: move. BOMB: drop a Fusebug.
io_t3a_g_fusebug_keys: Arrows or WASD: move. Space: drop a Fusebug.
io_t3a_g_flight_text:
Flap Balthazar through the fire vents and rock spires as far as you can. Grab embers on the way.

Solo: race the ghosts of the best flights.
Race: fly the same course as another player, at the same time.
io_t3a_g_smash_text:
Sixty seconds. Smash the Spurtz as they pop out of the lava. Chains of hits multiply your score; golden Spurtz are worth five times more. Don't smash the Fusebugs!

Versus: the same Spurtz for both of you; a golden one throws a Fusebug onto your rival's board.
io_t3a_g_breakout_text:
Bounce the Spurtz off your obsidian paddle and break the wall, level after level. Catch what falls: a wider paddle, more balls, a fireball. Three lives.

Versus: magma bricks you break push a new row down onto your rival's wall.
io_t3a_g_breakout_keys: Mouse or arrows: move. Click or Space: launch.
io_t3a_g_lavafloor_text:
The floor is crumbling into the lava: every tile you step on cracks and falls a moment later. Shove the others off, keep your feet, and be the last monster standing.

Solo: against five bots.
Live: two to six players (bots fill the gaps).
io_t3a_g_lavafloor_keys: Arrows or WASD: move. Space: shove.
io_t3a_g_bonebrawl_text:
Grab the bones lying about and throw them at the others. Three hits and you're out; every 30 seconds the lava closes in. Last one standing wins.

Solo: against five bots.
Live: two to six players (bots fill the gaps).
io_t3a_g_bonebrawl_touch: Stick: move. THROW: at the nearest. Or tap where to throw.
io_t3a_g_bonebrawl_keys: Arrows or WASD: move. Mouse: aim. Click: throw a bone.
io_t3a_g_hockey_text:
Knock the fireball into the other goal. First to 5 goals wins, or the most after three minutes.

Solo: against a bot.
1 v 1: against another player.
2 v 2: teams of two (bots fill in).
io_t3a_g_hockey_keys: Arrows or WASD: skate. Space: shoot.
io_t3a_g_soulsnatch_text:
Two teams, two souls. Steal the other team's soul from their base and carry it home while yours is safe. Touch a raider on your side to send them back. First to 3 captures wins.

Solo: you and a bot against two bots.
Live: teams of up to three (bots fill in).
io_t3a_g_soulsnatch_keys: Arrows or WASD: run. Space: dash.
io_t3a_g_stack_text:
Stack the falling blocks of bone, coal, sulfur and magma. Fill a row to clear it: the more rows at once, the more points. They fall faster as you go.

Versus: rows you clear push junk up into your rival's pit. Top out and you lose.
io_t3a_g_stack_touch: LEFT / RIGHT: move. TURN. DOWN: faster. DROP. HOLD.
io_t3a_g_stack_keys: Left / Right: move. Up: turn. Down: faster. Space: drop. C: hold.
io_t3a_g_swarm_text:
Balthazar against the swarm. Wave after wave of Spurtz, Zagnoids and Valgos dive at you. Grab the power-ups and keep your three lives.

Versus: the same waves for both of you; shoot a golden Spurtz to send a swarm at your rival. The higher score wins.
io_t3a_g_swarm_touch: Drag: fly. A finger down: fire.
io_t3a_g_swarm_keys: Mouse or arrows: fly. Hold the button or Space: fire.
io_t3a_g_runner_text:
Rezghul runs the endless road through the Inferno. Jump the rocks, slide under the fire bars, dodge the pillars and grab the embers. It only gets faster.

Race: the same road as another player, at the same time. The better run wins.
io_t3a_g_runner_touch: Tap left or right of Rezghul: change lane. Above him: jump. Below: slide.
io_t3a_g_runner_keys: Left / Right: change lane. Up or Space: jump. Down: slide.
io_t3a_g_golf_text:
Nine holes through the Inferno: bumpers, lava pools, spinning blades. Fewest strokes wins.

Daily: the same nine holes for everyone today; your best round counts.
Versus: play a course at the same time as another player.
io_t3a_g_golf_touch: Drag back from Valgos and let go to putt.
io_t3a_g_golf_keys: Drag back from Valgos and let go to putt.

io_t3t_tdui_blurb_129: Shakes all around it, ground only
io_t3t_tdui_rules1: Hold the Hall. Monsters pour in through the gap on the left and walk to your Under Hall on the right. Every one that gets there takes a life (bosses take more). Lose them all and the run is over.
io_t3t_tdui_rules2: Build a maze. Between waves, open the Yard Planner and place your walls (its Walls tool lays a whole line). The longer their way, the longer your towers have to shoot. You can't close the way completely: they must have a way through.
io_t3t_tdui_rules3: Buy towers from the shop with the gold you get for kills and cleared waves, and click a tower to upgrade its Damage, Fire rate or Range, or to sell it (all you paid back before the next wave starts, less after). Fliers (Balthazar) go straight over the maze: Sharpshooters, Magma Towers, Cinder Coils and Obsidian Mortars can hit them.
io_t3t_tdui_rules4: Every 10th wave a champion comes. Some waves give you more walls. How many waves can you survive?
io_t3t_tdui_keys: Keys: Space starts the wave, F the speed, P pauses, Tab picks the next tower, Q W E R upgrade it, S sells it.
io_t3t_tdui_note_all: Sold before the next wave, a tower gives back all it cost.
io_t3t_tdui_note_lvl: Every two upgrades raise its level.
io_t3t_tdui_lb_note: The Leaderboards' Hellgate tab shows everyone's best (it updates every few minutes).
io_t3t_tdui_link_coop_note: The Devil's Arcade keeps the waves you held together (its Hellgate page).
io_t3t_tdui_link_vs_note: The Devil's Arcade keeps the wins (its Hellgate page).

io_t3t_td2_pact_on: Blood Pact: kills pay double for 15 seconds!
io_t3t_td2_map_gate_blurb: The classic arena: in on the left, the Hall on the right.
io_t3t_td2_map_twin_blurb: Two ways in, top and bottom, and one Hall on the left. Split your defences, or make them meet.
io_t3t_td2_map_ravine_blurb: A bigger arena broken by obsidian ridges. Use the rock: it walls for free.
io_t3t_td2_map_cross_blurb: The Hall stands in the middle. They come from all four corners at once.
io_t3t_td2_perk_bounty_text: +6% gold for each kill a level.
io_t3t_td2_perk_veterans_text: Towers rank up 30% faster a level.
io_t3t_td2_perk_interest_text: Each wave cleared pays 2% of your gold a level (150 at most).

io_t3t_td2_mut_famine_text: Kills pay 40% less; cleared waves pay 50% more.
io_t3t_td2_mut_masons_text: 30 more walls to start, none from waves.
io_t3t_td2ui_rules1: Everything from Hellgate Defense, and twice as much. Wall a maze with the Yard Planner and hold the Hall.
io_t3t_td2ui_rules2: Twelve towers: the shop has two shelves. Hellforged towers slow, poison, drum up the towers near them, make gold, throw boulders and hunt fliers.
io_t3t_td2ui_rules3: Four upgrade paths: each tower's Special is its own (crits, burning, stuns...). Towers rank up with their kills.
io_t3t_td2ui_rules4: Spells (keys 1 to 4) charge while waves are on: Meteor (click the ground), Frost Nova, Blood Pact, Moloch's Wrath.
io_t3t_td2ui_rules5: Elites wear coloured marks: Armored, Swift, Regenerating, Splitting, Warded, Mending. Venom eats armour.
io_t3t_td2ui_rules6: Bosses have powers. Wave 40 brings the Hellgate Warden: beat it to win the map. Then play on as long as you last.

io_t3t_joke_01: Why did the imp cross the lava? He didn't. Ow.
io_t3t_joke_02: I asked Moloch for a raise. He raised the heat.
io_t3t_joke_03: My favourite tool? The pitch-fork... it's a pitch-perfect fork.
io_t3t_joke_04: Knock knock. Who's there? Magma. Magma who? Magma-nificent yard, boss!
io_t3t_joke_05: What do you call a lazy worker? Me, on my break.
io_t3t_joke_06: Hot tip: never hug a Cinder Coil.
io_t3t_joke_08: Overtime in the Inferno? It's always over time down here.
io_t3t_joke_09: They say it's lonely at the top. Good thing we live at the bottom.
io_t3t_joke_10: My hard hat isn't hard. It's just very confident.
io_t3t_joke_11: What's a worker's favourite dance? The brimstone shuffle.
io_t3t_joke_13: Lunch today: hot rocks. Dinner: hotter rocks.
io_t3t_joke_14: Why don't imps play cards? Too many fiery dealers.
io_t3t_joke_15: I tried to cool off once. Worst three seconds of my life.
io_t3t_joke_16: My boss says I'm on fire. My boss is right. Please help.
io_t3t_joke_17: Smoke break? Boss, everything here is a smoke break.
io_t3t_joke_18: What do you call a worker with no hammer? Unemployed.
io_t3t_joke_19: Knock knock. Who's there? Ash. Ash who? Bless you!
io_t3t_joke_20: I wanted to be a firefighter. Bad career choice for down here.
io_t3t_joke_21: Why was the Sulphur Pit so calm? It just let off some steam.
io_t3t_joke_22: I nailed it! Well, I nailed something. Hopefully the wall.
io_t3t_joke_23: Why are skeletons such bad builders? No guts.
io_t3t_joke_24: I put the 'hell' in 'hello'. And the 'ow' in 'tower'.
io_t3t_joke_25: Retirement plan? Cool down in about ten thousand years.
io_t3t_joke_26: Did you hear about the lava lamp? It's a real hot-head.
io_t3t_joke_27: Why do workers love the Inferno? The heating is free.
io_t3t_joke_28: I measure twice and cut once. Then I set it on fire.

io_t3k_sh_scaled2: %, so the game is drawn at a lower resolution and stretched, which looks soft. "Sharpest" draws it at your screen's own resolution: much crisper, a little slower.
io_t3k_sh_ui_hint: Draws the whole game larger, still sharp, as far as the window leaves room for it (at least 760×670 at the game's own size). A big window or full screen shows the most.
io_t3k_sh_battery_hint: One click: Balanced (75%) resolution and no frame interpolation. Less drawing, so less heat and battery.
io_t3k_sh_dyn_hint: Lowers the resolution automatically while the game can't keep up, and raises it again when it can.
io_t3k_sh_ip_hint: The game runs at 40 frames a second. This shows made-up frames between them, so moving things look smoother (best on a 120 Hz or faster screen). Costs more drawing; shows the game a fraction of a frame later. Frames that don't fit in time are left out. Auto draws once at every refresh of your screen, timed to it, whatever its rate.
io_t3k_sh_glow_hint: Off: no glows around monsters, buttons and text. Faster on slow devices, but some text is harder to read.
io_t3k_sh_light_hint: Off: the yard as it was drawn, with no light, no shadows cast by buildings, monsters and pets, and no Halloween cobwebs. Faster on slow devices.
io_t3k_sh_gl_hint: On: the yard is drawn by your graphics card, much faster in big battles. Turn it off if the yard looks wrong. Computers without one draw it the old way anyway.

io_t3k_sh_ios2: , and start the game from the new icon.
io_t3k_sh_touch_hint: Drag with one finger to scroll the map, pinch with two to zoom, or drag with two to move the map without zooming. Double-tap the yard to zoom in, and again to zoom back out.
io_t3k_sh_f10_hint: In full screen, F10 (or the gear that shows at the top corner) opens these settings, and Esc closes them.

io_t3m_sg_hint: Up to #v1# letters. Everyone who looks at your yard can click the sign and read it.
io_t3m_sk_molten_line: Black rock split by glowing lava.
io_t3m_sk_crimson_line: Blood red, smouldering at the edges.
io_t3m_sk_abyss_line: Deep sea teal, lit from within.
io_t3m_sk_solidgold_line: Polished gold all over: a statue come alive.
io_t3m_dc_ground_intro: Select your terrain: the ground your yard stands on. Everyone who visits or attacks your yard sees it. The last three are opened by inviting friends.
io_t3m_dc_chat_intro: The colour of your name in chat, for everyone who reads it.
io_t3m_dc_workers_intro: How your workers look in all your yards, to you and to everyone who visits.
io_t3m_dc_champs_intro: Your champions' looks: at home, in your attacks and to everyone who visits (from their next time out). Skins are #v1# Shiny each, yours for good.
io_t3m_dc_hfo_lock: Win the last wave of\nHell Freezes Over
io_t3m_dc_emotes_intro: Chat emotes, free for everyone in the Club: press the face button beside Say in the chat bar and pick one (up to #v1# in a line). The ones that move, move for everyone.
io_t3m_dc_signs_intro: Signs are free: put up to #v1# in your yard and write on them.
io_t3m_dc_signs_how: Build a Sign with the button below (or from Buildings, Decorations, Flags & Signs). Click it in your yard and press Write to put a message on it (up to #v1# letters). Everyone who looks at your yard, visitors and attackers alike, can click it to read it.
io_t3m_pm_placing: Placing #v1#s: #v2# to go. Click the yard for each (Esc to stop).
io_t3m_ui_designer_kits: The kit popup isn't used in the Designer. Build the kit's buildings here, then Save.
io_fmi3_bar_standing: Yard destroyed: #v1#% · #v2# buildings standing (the last one down loses the wave)
io_live_title_yard: #v1# is attacking your yard! Nothing in it can be done until it's over.
io_live_title_outpost: #v1# is attacking your outpost! Nothing in it can be done until it's over.
io_live_over_hint: #v1#'s attack is over: your yard is yours again.
io_live_alert_yard:
#v1# is attacking your yard!

Watch it as it happens? Nothing in the yard can be done until the attack is over.
io_live_alert_outpost:
#v1# is attacking your outpost at #v2#!

Watch it as it happens?
io_live_norecord: #v1# is attacking your yard. This attack isn't being recorded, so it can't be watched: you can open the Map Room until it's over.
io_live_cant: That attack can't be watched any more.
io_watch_tip: Watch anyone's attacks, Brimstone Pit games and Arcade games as they happen.
io_watch_sub: #v1# things live now · pick a name to follow that player
io_watch_sub_none: When something goes live, pick a name to follow that player
io_watch_sub_one: 1 thing live now · pick a name to follow that player
io_watch_none: Nothing is live right now. Watch all waits for the next thing to start.
io_watch_failed: The list couldn't be loaded. Trying again...
io_watch_waiting_user: #v1# isn't doing anything you can watch right now. Waiting for them...
io_watch_waiting_all: Nothing is live right now. Waiting for the next thing to start...
io_watch_over_hint: Watching what's next in a moment...
io_watch_row_casino: #v1# is playing #v2# in the Brimstone Pit
io_watch_row_arcade: #v1# is playing #v2# in the Devil's Arcade
io_t3k_sh_cap_hint: How many times a second the game is drawn, at most: its FPS (60 unless you choose). The game itself always updates 40 times a second, its ticks, whatever this is: over 40 FPS, the frames between ticks are smoothed, timed to your screen. No limit draws at every refresh of your screen (a browser can't show more). Higher costs more drawing, so more heat and battery.
io_t3k_sh_battery_hint2: One click: Balanced (75%) resolution, a 40 fps limit and no light and shadows. Less drawing, so less heat and battery.
io_t3k_sh_show_hint: FPS: how many times a second the game is drawn (up to the frame rate limit). Ticks: how many times a second the game itself is updated (monsters, attacks, timers): 40, whatever the FPS.
io_cru_desc: Pour surplus bone, coal, sulfur or magma into the fire and take another back. Each level gives a better rate and lets you pour more in a day.
io_cru_special: Level #v1#: pour up to #v2#% of your storage a day.
io_cru_own_yard: The Soul Crucible can only be used in your own main yard.
io_cru_head: Level #v1#: up to #v2#% of your storage a day. Higher levels give better rates.
io_cru_pick: Pick what to pour, what to take, and how much.
io_cru_err_cap: Today's #v1# is poured. Come back tomorrow, or upgrade the Soul Crucible.
io_cru_err_min: The least you can pour is #v1#.
io_cru_err_room: Your storage has room for #v1# more #v2#. Pour less.
io_cru_rate: #v1# into #v2# gives back #v3#% at this level.
io_cru_today_cap: Poured today: #v1# of #v2# (#v3#% of your storage a day)
io_fb_login_first: Log in to send a report
io_fb_reload_ask: Reload the game? Anything not saved yet may be lost.
io_fb_pick_hint: Click the picture to pick something else, or drag to draw a box around it.
io_fb_sent_with: Sent with it: where you are in the game, your last few clicks and the game's version.
io_fb_q_bug: What happened? What did you expect instead?
io_fb_q_idea: What would you change, and why?
io_fb_err_short: Please write a little more (at least #v1# characters).
io_fb_err_limit: You've sent a lot of reports: please try again later.
io_fb_thanks: Thank you! You can follow it under My reports.
io_fb_mine_none: You haven't sent any reports yet.
io_fb_settings_hint_touch: A screenshot of the game goes with it: tap it to show what you mean.
io_fb_settings_hint: Or right-click anything in the game: it is highlighted in your report.
